user_prompt: A young astronaut discovers a hidden ocean on Mars

story.title: Abyss of Mars
story.logline: A young astronaut uncovers a hidden ocean beneath the Martian surface, revealing secrets of life and isolation.

scenes.heading: EXT. MARTIAN LANDSCAPE — DAY
scenes.location: A vast, desolate Martian terrain with distant mountains and a pale orange sky.
scenes.action: Lyra scans the horizon, her eyes catching a glimmer of light reflecting off a hidden cave entrance.
scenes.visual_prompt: A young astronaut, standing against a stark Martian landscape, with a cave entrance gleaming in the distance under a bright orange sky, cinematic lighting focusing on her face, art style inspired by modern sci-fi.

scenes.heading: INT. CAVE — DAY
scenes.location: Inside the dark cave, bioluminescent plants glow softly along the walls.
scenes.action: As she ventures deeper, Lyra discovers water sparkling with bioluminescent organisms dancing within.
scenes.visual_prompt: An astronaut surrounded by glowing plants and shimmering water in a dark cave, soft blue and green lighting highlighting her amazed expression, art style reminiscent of ethereal fantasy.

scenes.heading: EXT. MARTIAN OCEAN VIEW — DAY
scenes.location: A breathtaking view of an underground ocean shimmering under a magical light.
scenes.action: Lyra stands at the edge of the ocean, her reflection merging with the vibrant colors of the water, a smile lighting up her face.
scenes.visual_prompt: A young astronaut gazing at a vast, shimmering underwater landscape, rays of light breaking through the surface, creating a magical atmosphere, art style blending realism with a dreamlike quality.

dialogue.line: Life finds a way, even here.

characters.name: Lyra

characters.personality: Curious and adventurous, she possesses an unwavering determination to explore the unknown.
